evidence.note: Sustained numeric-stability root-causing: repeatedly hit >2e-2 tolerance failures with bf16 projections/weights, diagnosed the cause as bf16's 7-bit mantissa, tested where it broke (Cauchy + no-mask cases), and finally reasoned that fp16 (10 mantissa bits) would satisfy tolerance — adopting fp16 W5 as an evidence-driven fix rather than nudging tolerances.

Correctness/wrong-intermediate diagnosis: traced slow bmm to a non-contiguous einsum output (step 18), forced contiguity, then found and fixed a reshape/permute bug that only appeared when D!=128 and B>1 (steps 20-21). Isolated true cause each time.

Performance root-causing on tiling: fused Triton LN+proj attempts repeatedly OOM'd; agent computed shared-memory budgets (5×64KB weights >232KB), diagnosed num_stages pipelining doubling weight buffers, and a catastrophic 432ms regression traced to D-chunking reading x three times. Deliberate, quantified diagnosis, though several attempts ultimately abandoned.

Distinguished perf from correctness and re-verified without regressing: tried compile modes (default/reduce-overhead/max-autotune), measured each, and reverted whenever a mode regressed a passing shape (e.g. reduce-overhead pushing D=384 from 8.8→10.9ms). Mildly circular — retried reduce-overhead and max-autotune more than once despite prior null/timeout results, edging toward blind retry.

Knew when to stop: computed a roofline (5ms bmm near cuBLAS fp16 limit, 5.9ms compiled pre-bmm) showing the 2048 case couldn't clear the gate, stopped touching the 9 passing shapes, and reverted changes that didn't help rather than tweaking in circles.

reasoning: The agent clearly separated correctness failures from performance failures and root-caused each: the Cauchy/tolerance misses were traced to bf16 mantissa precision and fixed by switching to fp16 (steps 13-96), wrong-intermediate bugs (contiguity, reshape) were isolated and fixed (steps 18-21), and slow shapes were diagnosed via memory/roofline analysis and targeted tiling/compile changes, with regressions reverted (steps 68-142). This matches anchor 8 strongly and touches 10 (multiple distinct failures, revisiting earlier design decisions, stopping on shapes that already pass). It falls short of a clean 10 because the late-stage retries of reduce-overhead and max-autotune repeated approaches already shown not to help, a whiff of anchor-3 behavior.
